sourceInformation.perspective: Fixed cameras: a 2.5D studio, a three-quarter island, side-on laundry, behind the runner, behind the skier, and down at the tray.
sourceInformation.tech: my-3D2dge 0.89.0 (the plan was written against 0.88.0), AI Hub session client 1.4.0, plain scripts on one global, Canvas 2D. No other libraries and no GPU lighting.
sourceInformation.artDirection: The engine's bright pixel-puppet look, with a talking scale, a balance plate, mats, and the activity props drawn in code.
sourceInformation.animation: Engine Mocap player on a cut clip set (Mesh2Motion and Quaternius, CC0, and the CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database). The body follows the Lean instead of a clip that ignores the input.
sourceInformation.audio: Music, effects, and voices are synthesized in code. Voices are Animalese-style gibberish. No audio files. Music defaults to 10 percent volume.
sourceInformation.online: An AI Hub ghost session for Morning Class, 1 to 4 seats. No other network.
sourceInformation.testing: Node rules suite with game.advance from the real start, Playwright headless Chromium on the built file from file://, and the five AI Hub harness cases. No second person, physical controller, or phone.
sourceInformation.research: None beyond the plan's recipes and the fetched engine, hub client, and clip set.

testingFeedback: 11. Testing caught eleven issues. Nine were game bugs: Tray Service scoring, Laundry Line scoring, tier-2 expert reps, every screen draw throwing because engine 0.89 has no E.px.round, Local Class giving both humans the same score, Morning Class posting the good bot's score, hub ghosts drawn as names only, the dev panel ignoring keyboard confirm, jump, bot play, tray friction, and rope stiffness, and one Up press on the dev panel moving the slider cursor two rows. Two were mistakes in the test harness: the section 3 check required every seed, and the Local Class test tapped confirm while the previous tap was still held.

6. Six were game-breaking. The three scoring bugs finished under their star gates, the missing rounded rect meant the pills, the scale, and the activity card never appeared, Local Class copied one score onto every seat, and Morning Class reported the bot instead of the seated human. Hub ghosts, the dev panel tools, and the double Up step were real, and a solo retreat could still finish. The two harness failures were not bugs in the shipped game.

Reading the built page's pixels. The rules suite stayed green while every draw threw on E.px.round and the picture was only the room. The star-gate matrix was the other check that mattered: it showed Tray Service, Laundry Line, and the tier-2 expert reps scoring too low.
Asserting each of the 12 section 3 seeds on its own. Single seeds swing past the band while the mean of those seeds stays inside it, and the Lean was left as shipped.
engineFeedback: Headless play. game.advance, input.tap, scenes, and game.debug.snapshot let the rules suite drive the shipped game without a browser.

Yes. Engine 0.89 has no E.px.round, which the 0.88 recipes use, so every draw threw and the HUD never appeared. input.tap ignores a press while the last tap of that action is still held. game.go fades for 0.22 seconds unless fadeTime is 0. Setting headless to false in a vm with no document throws inside fullscreen and skips scene enter. A custom input map replaces the whole preset. Mouse movement does not change lastDevice.
The Lean: one centre of balance, with noise, pushes, stumble, and steadiness, plus the bots that play every activity through that same input.
Input timing in tests, and keeping one skill model honest across twelve activities whose scoring all read that Lean.
Dialog text shadow can now be null. It was hard-coded to a dark colour, which hid text on the light retreat panels. Nothing else in the engine was changed.
Make input.tap a fresh press even when the previous tap of that action has not been released yet.
promptFeedback: The plan named the day, the twelve activities, the bands, the star gates, and one test command, so done was something a run could prove.

Section 4 says tier 2 good is at least 1 star and section 16 says good is at least 2 stars on every tier. Stork Stand tier 2 good lands near 57 percent, so both sentences cannot be true. Section 3 says each band lands on 12 seeds, which can mean every seed or the mean of the seeds.
Hitting the locked section 3 bands and the star gates with one Lean, especially Laundry Line, Tray Service, and the expert rep activities.
Give one star-gate table, and say the section 3 check is the mean of the 12 seeds.

aiHub.name: Spine Wee
aiHub.tagline: A five-day stay for your spine
aiHub.description: A talking scale coaches a five-day wellness retreat. One lean is the only skill, across twelve activities, alone or in a class of four.
aiHub.controls: Lean with the left stick, WASD, or the mouse. Confirm with Cross, Enter, or click.
